issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and other workflows
issues.desc: Loan Simple leads were generating duplicate tasks across multiple workflows including post-referral, pre-referral, and sale pending. The issue was traced to a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot. HubSpot support was engaged and the filter issue was resolved.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or dismiss the duplicate tasks.

issues.title: LO name not updating in automated emails after loan officer change
issues.desc: When a loan officer was changed on a deal, automated emails continued to reference the previous LO rather than the updated one. The issue was identified on a specific deal where emails still showed the prior LO Paul instead of the updated LO Julie Yocum. Luis resolved the issue directly.
issues.workaround: For any deals where the LO was changed during the impact window, manually resend any automated agent-facing emails with the correct LO information.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: The post-referral workflow continued sending check-in tasks to HAs even after deals were marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow lacked proper unenrollment filters for these terminal deal stages. A tweak to the workflow filters was made to address the issue.
issues.workaround: Manually dismiss any post-referral tasks received on deals that were already marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-triggering after deal stage reverted and reset
issues.desc: When a deal was marked Offer Accepted, reverted to a prior stage (e.g., Committed or Referred Active), and then set back to Offer Accepted, the TC workflow tasks did not re-trigger on the second Offer Accepted change. The root cause was that deal stage re-enrollment criteria did not include 'Offer Accepted' as a re-enrollment trigger. The workflow was updated to add this as a re-enrollment criterion.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any deals that were moved back to Offer Accepted a second time during the impact window so TCs receive the appropriate tasks.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow not triggering tasks for referral accepted on March 18th
issues.desc: A referral made and accepted on March 18th did not trigger any post-referral workflow tasks for the HA. The root cause was identified as a data-pulling error that prevented the workflow filter from evaluating correctly. The issue was escalated to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll the affected deal into the post-referral workflow and complete any outstanding tasks that should have been generated since March 18th.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent in Offer Accepted stage before credit amount is available
issues.desc: An SMS notifying the buyer of their credit amount was being sent when deals entered the Offer Accepted stage, even though closing information had not yet been submitted and the credit amount could not be calculated. The SMS should only send at the Sale Pending stage once the credit amount is known. It was confirmed to be a dash-triggered communication and was escalated to the product team.
issues.workaround: For any buyers who received the incomplete credit SMS during Offer Accepted, manually send a follow-up communication with the correct credit amount once closing information is submitted.
